admission.justification: The writer and recorded reader depend on the same exact-name rule, and a short name with several targets must not be silently reduced to one span.

applicability: Lean symbol anchor lookup for one file in the paired code tree.
conditions: The requested key is a verified full name or is a name as written in the source.
A full-name hit takes precedence over a written alias.
exclusions: Suffix search for a Lean name.
statement: Lean symbol anchors use exact bindings with full-name precedence and expose ambiguity to the writer.
